apps_with_blockers: DealCloud
No self-serve account or credential creation — API/MCP access requires already being a paying DealCloud/Intapp customer with an admin role to provision credentials.
Gladly
Requires becoming a paying Gladly customer via a sales-led demo/contract (no self-serve signup) before any API token can be issued.
WhatsApp Business
Full production access requires Meta Business verification/approval; unverified test mode is capped at 250 conversations/24h and 5 numbers.
Aircall
Requires being a paying Aircall customer (Basic Auth uses api_id/api_token issued only to subscribed accounts) to obtain API credentials.
Google Ads
Developer token application review (Basic/Standard Access) plus OAuth2 client setup and Required Minimum Functionality compliance.
Meta Ads
App Review + Business Verification required for advanced permissions or managing accounts you don't own.
LinkedIn Ads
Marketing Developer Platform partner program application and review gates nearly all ads endpoints.
Pinterest
Trial access application/review is required before most non-trivial endpoints (including ads) become usable, plus a second review for Standard access.
Threads (Meta)
Meta App Review required to move beyond self/tester accounts into production for third-party use.
Salesforce Commerce Cloud
No free self-serve developer sandbox; obtaining any environment requires sales/partner engagement or existing paid customer entitlement.
Squarespace
OAuth app registration requires manual Squarespace review, and the official MCP server does not yet cover core commerce operations.
Amazon Selling Partner API
Mandatory developer identity verification plus per-application-type approval (and separate Restricted Data Token approval) gates programmatic access.
fanbasis
Detailed docs require an authenticated account login to view in full, and it's unconfirmed whether a free/trial merchant account is sufficient for a working API key.
Ahrefs
Requires a paid plan (from $129/mo) for real API/MCP access, and the MCP endpoint disallows generic custom-client usage.
Sherlock
No hosted/official network API — an agent toolkit must shell out to the CLI as a subprocess rather than call a remote endpoint.
Waterfall.io
No confirmed public self-serve signup — obtaining an initial API key appears to require going through 'Book a call'/sales.
Clay
Full programmatic access is tiered behind paid plans, and the Public API itself is very new (since ~mid-2026).
Smartsheet
Requires a paid Smartsheet plan (Business/Enterprise/Advanced Work Management) to obtain any API access.
Binance
Live trading requires KYC-verified account and is geographically restricted in some jurisdictions.
Paygent Connect
Could not locate a public developer portal or API reference specifically for 'Paygent Connect'; the name 'Paygent' is heavily overloaded across several unrelated companies.
QuickBooks
Production/app-store approval is needed to serve real, non-developer customers at scale (sandbox alone is fine for a demo).
Brex
Requires an existing, funded Brex business account with admin access to obtain any credentials.
Ramp
Production API access requires partner or customer approval; primary docs site could not be fully rendered to verify exact details.
PitchBook
No public developer docs, API reference, or self-serve credentials exist; access requires a sales conversation and commercial contract with undisclosed terms/pricing.
NotebookLM
Consumer NotebookLM is blocked (no API); the enterprise variant only works inside an org that already has a Google Cloud project and licenses.
Otter AI
No generic API key/developer program; an agent toolkit can only be built against the official OAuth MCP server's 3 read-only tools.
Consensus
The general-purpose REST API requires a sales application and custom quote; agents can practically only reach Consensus via the free/no-account OAuth MCP server, which has tighter limits.
Devin
Requires a paid Devin/Cognition account before any key can be generated; no free trial API tier confirmed.
Grain
Requires at minimum a paid Starter-plan Grain subscription to generate any API token; the Free plan has zero API access.
